dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello, Rachel. This is Daniel Lim. I'm calling about my personal portfolio after reviewing my arrangements. I have my details here. My FIN is F seven five eight zero two six five P. My date of birth is the twenty-eighth of December nineteen fifty-two.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Daniel. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I can speak now. I'm in my office with the door closed. I'd prefer to keep the call practical and fairly brief; there's a business discussion coming up, and I don't want to be interrupted halfway through this.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly. I'll keep the conversation focused and leave room for anything you want to raise. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The holding I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I would like to buy— Sorry, I meant sell. I want to reduce my existing holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your objective is to reduce your exposure to emerging-market debt and make your personal assets more readily available for anticipated spending.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I've also been trying to spend more time away from work. The family business tends to fill any space I leave in the diary. Even when I'm not at the office, the staff still call me about routine matters.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Would you prefer that routine banking updates come by telephone, or would a written message be easier when you're away?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: A concise telephone update usually suits me best. If there's paperwork to review, send that through the usual channel. I would rather read it when I'm back at my desk than try to deal with documents while travelling.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that communication preference. If you miss a call, you can return it when you have privacy rather than discussing personal banking around colleagues. I recommend reducing your holding in Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because that would lower your exposure to emerging-market debt and release assets for your anticipated spending.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you for putting that plainly. Please keep any routine voicemail brief as well. I sometimes listen to messages while I'm with family, so I'd rather hear only that you've called and need me to get in touch.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep voicemail messages limited to a request to return the call, without account details. You can also let us know if your availability changes while you're away.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would be useful. I haven't settled my travel plans yet, so there's nothing to arrange around them today. Let me give you the remaining details now. Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. The transaction amount should be 25,000,000. The quantity I want to transact is 1,000 units. Please place this as a market order.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee for this sale is 0.25%. You may lose some or all of the capital you invested.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: There's something else about the original investment that I need to tell you. The money I originally put into this holding came from undeclared cash receipts from my business. I routed it through a relative's account to conceal where it came from.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 25,000,000 in Japanese yen. Is that your final instruction?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm the final transaction instruction exactly as you have just stated it. Please execute it.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Daniel. That concludes the telephone discussion. Please use the usual banking channel if you need to contact me about the paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Rachel. I'll leave it there and get back to my day. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Goodbye, Daniel.
